# Portable Blender 4.5.8 initialization kit

These are native Blender 4.5.8 kit bodies, not newly Blender-generated files. Fixed-width file-browser directory fields were cleared by the committed privacy sanitizer after Oxblend's typed rewrite reported unsupported_edit. Linked library references are relative. The manifest records before/after hashes and the exact changed fields, without host paths.

Generator: integration/file_ops_kit.py. These fixtures exercise generic serialized types, ownership and pointer diagnostics. They are not product templates or proof of evaluated/render behavior.
